India Defeats West Indies in T20I; Iyer Hits Century, Dhir Impresses on Debut

India secured an 8-wicket victory over the West Indies in a T20 International match. Shreyas Iyer scored his maiden T20I century, while debutant Naman Dhir took 3 wickets and contributed to the win. Dhir expressed his anticipation for future opportunities if given the chance.
